why: WCAG's 0.05 term models ambient flare and is what bounds the ratio at 21. Without it black against white divides by zero (Infinity) and #777777 on white reads 5.42 instead of 4.48 -- a mid-grey that fails the 4.5 text floor would pass it, and the High contrast 3:1 floor would be measured on an inflated scale. Measured with colour-distance.ts on 2026-10-10 (origin/main c200cf62 plus issue #1056).
killedBy: WCAG contrast ratio is 21 for black against white, 1 for a colour against itself, and the same either way round
